prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single finished landscape product-card artwork for Wallet Top-up, a Discord bot feature that lets members add funds to their own wallet.
Input image: the supplied Review Credit artwork is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE. Preserve the same white ceramic floating bot head, glossy obsidian face with two glowing blurple square eyes, round lavender glass platform, prominent actual white Discord Clyde emblem on a round blurple enamel badge on the platform front, pearl-white studio backdrop, refined lighting, camera angle, high-quality materials and scale. Change the feature-related objects completely.
Primary request: beautiful premium 3D artwork clearly communicating adding funds to a member wallet through a Discord bot. NO TEXT anywhere.
Scene/subject: one cute friendly floating white ceramic bot head to center-right above the platform. In front of it to center-left sits one elegant compact three-dimensional wallet, visually unmistakable as a folded wallet with rounded corners, tasteful stitched edge, layered folded silhouette and small silver snap clasp; outer finish is sophisticated satin Discord blurple #5865F2 with pearl white inner rim. The wallet is slightly open at the top. A restrained curved arc of THREE warm gold coins flows downward into the open wallet, with one coin midway above the opening and the others behind in perspective, clearly showing incoming funds rather than a static pile. Coin faces are plain smooth gold with a raised simple plus pictogram ONLY, absolutely no monetary lettering. One small floating mint-green translucent circular badge with a white raised plus symbol near the wallet reinforces top-up. Bot eyes look gently toward the wallet. Cohesive balanced central sculpture with no extra gadgets.
Platform: round translucent lavender glass plinth with beautiful edge refraction. Prominent white Discord Clyde logo on a circular blurple enamel badge centered on front face of plinth. Correct recognizable Discord logo silhouette, two round eye cutouts. One tiny green connected status light alongside it.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9, around 1672x941 or higher; wallet and bot are equally important readable focal points, centered within safe margins, all main objects fully visible. Preserve airy breathing room and quiet upper-left corner for website overlay badge. No typography column.
Style/medium: sophisticated premium CGI product campaign; tactile ceramic, realistic satin leather-like wallet surface, brushed metal clasp, softly brushed warm gold coins, refractive lavender glass. Soft large studio key light from upper left, precise restrained highlights, gentle purple-blue rim lighting, realistic soft shadows, seamless near-white to pale lavender studio with subtly reflective matte floor. White, silver, Discord blurple and lavender palette, warm gold and restrained mint accents. Charming, luxurious and very polished, thumbnail-readable.
Constraints: one bot, one wallet, three coins, one plus badge, one glass platform and Discord emblem. No review speech bubbles, hearts, stars, checks, headphones, speakers, sound waves, servers, bank cards, credit-card numbers, banknotes, charts or QR codes. NO text, letters, numbers, currency signs, watermarks, UI screenshots, labels, wordmark, card frame or border. Only the Discord logo and simple plus pictograms are permitted symbols. No hands, humans or robot limbs. Avoid clutter, exaggerated neon and financial-growth imagery. Render the finished artwork itself, not a website mockup.
